description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter frontend application named 'con_living_frontend'. It sets up the app with a custom color theme, and displays a simple home screen with a message indicating the app is being generated.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that sets up the MaterialApp with a custom theme and the home screen.

classes.name: _HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the Scaffold containing the AppBar and centered text.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main entry point of the application that calls runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overrides StatelessWidget's build method to construct the widget tree for MyApp and _HomeScreen.
